_README: Provenance for every document in kb/corpus/. Each corpus file names its source_id here. Nothing enters the knowledge base without an entry in this file, because a RAG system that cites unverifiable text is worse than one with no citations at all: it manufactures false confidence. Retrieved 2026-09-05.

sources.title: FFIEC BSA/AML Examination Manual, Appendix F: Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing "Red Flags"
sources.used_for: Funds-transfer and shell-company red flag indicators. This is the list US bank examiners actually work from, which is why it is the primary red-flag source rather than a vendor blog.

sources.title: FFIEC BSA/AML Examination Manual, Appendix G: Structuring
sources.used_for: The legal definition of structuring (31 CFR 1010.100(xx)), the $10,000 CTR threshold and $3,000 monetary-instrument recordkeeping threshold, and the explicit warning that two sub-threshold transactions days apart are NOT automatically structuring.

sources.title: FFIEC BSA/AML Examination Manual, Appendix L: SAR Quality Guidance
sources.used_for: The who/what/when/where/why/how frame and the 'modus operandi' requirement for a narrative.

sources.title: SAR Narrative Guidance Package, Part I: Guidance on Preparing a Complete and Sufficient Suspicious Activity Report Narrative
sources.used_for: The introduction / body / conclusion narrative structure the agent's case note template mirrors.

sources.title: FinCEN Advisory FIN-2014-A005: U.S. Currency Restrictions in Mexico — Funnel Accounts and Trade-Based Money Laundering
sources.used_for: The funnel-account definition and red flags. Directly relevant: a funnel account is the real-world name for the FAN-IN shape this project detects.

sources.title: FinCEN Advisory FIN-2020-A003: Advisory on Imposter Scams and Money Mule Schemes Related to COVID-19
sources.used_for: The unwitting / witting / complicit money-mule taxonomy, which the agent uses to reason about disposition rather than only about detection.

sources.title: 31 CFR § 1020.320 — Reports by banks of suspicious transactions
sources.used_for: The SAR filing deadline: 30 calendar days from initial detection, extendable to 60 if no suspect is identified.

sources.title: Getting to Effectiveness — Report on U.S. Financial Institution Resources Devoted to BSA/AML & Sanctions Compliance
sources.content_type: reported figures, with our own derived ratios shown as derived
sources.used_for: Alert economics. This is the PRIMARY SOURCE behind the '90-95% of AML alerts are false positives' figure that vendor marketing repeats without attribution. Survey of 19 US banks, $50bn-$500bn+ in assets.

sources.title: Virtual Assets Red Flag Indicators of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing
sources.used_for: Relevant because Bitcoin is one of the fifteen currencies in the dataset. Based on 100+ case studies from the FATF Global Network.

sources.title: HI-Small_Patterns.txt typology labels (IBM synthetic AML transaction generator)
sources.content_type: dataset ground truth, mapped by us to regulatory typologies
sources.used_for: The eight injected pattern shapes. The MAPPING from these shapes to real-world typologies and red flags is our own synthesis and is labelled as such wherever it appears.
